outs.note: The show said Norman Powell is out for the 11/25 game against Charlotte. He has not played since 11/20.

Jalen Smith was moved from questionable to out for tonight (gastrointestinal illness) on the NBA's 05:00 PM injury report. He had averaged 28 minutes over his last 5 games, so those minutes go to teammates; the injury page lists who gains.
The show said Caleb Wilson is out again on 11/25. He has not played since 11/11, and the show said Isaac Okoro and Patrick Williams pick up some of his role.
Grayson Allen was questionable on the morning of 11/25 and was later ruled out under the concussion protocol. The show said his status probably matters a little for Coby White's role.
The show said Dennis Schroder is out for 11/25. He has not played since 11/04.

Zach LaVine was moved from questionable to out for tonight (right knee soreness) on the NBA's 05:30 PM injury report. He had averaged 33 minutes over his last 5 games, so those minutes go to teammates; the injury page lists who gains.
Holmgren remained out Wednesday against Atlanta. Isaiah Hartenstein grabbed 17 rebounds in his place.

The show said Oklahoma City is still without Aday Mara, Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams for 11/25. Mara has not played since 11/20, and Holmgren is out 8 to 10 weeks with a small patellar tendon tear.
The show said Wallace is presumably out for the season. He has not played since Oct. 25.

Morant has a left hamstring strain and has not played since October 29. RotoWire lists December 1 as his earliest return, and the show estimated at least two more weeks until there are reports of contact work.
The show thinks Chris Youngblood will be out a while longer. He has a right heel contusion and has not played in Portland's recent games.

The show said Cameron Boozer is out at least four weeks. He has already missed Memphis's games on 11/21 and 11/23. The show said no one on the roster is likely to become a full-time replacement for his role.
The show said Jerami Grant is hurt, which takes another forward out of the Memphis rotation while Cameron Boozer is out. Grant did not play on 11/21 or 11/23 after playing only 5 minutes on 11/19.
